 Steven Adams (calf) remains out Saturday 
 by Leo Sells | Rockets Correspondent | Sat, Nov 7th 2026, 2:05pm EST 
 Steven Adams (calf) remains out for Saturday's game against the Phoenix Suns. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 The big man is going to remain out for another game on Saturday as he continues to recover from a nagging calf injury. The Rockets have also ruled out Clint Capela (ankle), so they will be significantly lacking depth behind Alperen Sengun in this matchup against Phoenix.
